parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the **RequestId** as the **ClientToken**. The **RequestId** of each API request may be different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

> 若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的**RequestId**作为**ClientToken**标识。每次API请求的**RequestId**可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the FULLNAT table to which the FULLNAT entries belong.

> You must specify at least one of **FullNatTableId** and **NatGatewayId**
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的FULLNAT条目所属的FULLNAT表ID。


>**FullNatTableId**和**NatGatewayId**参数至少输入一个
parameters.name: full_nat_table_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the FULLNAT entry to query
parameters.name: full_nat_entry_id

parameters.help_en:
The names of the FULLNAT entries to query. You can specify up to 20 names.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_). The name must start with a letter or Chinese character
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的FULLNAT条目的名称。最多支持查询20个FULLNAT条目的名称。

名称长度在2~128个字符之间，以英文字母或中文开头，可包含数字、短划线（-）和下划线（_）
parameters.name: full_nat_entry_names

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the elastic network interfaces (ENIs) to query
parameters.name: network_interface_ids

parameters.help_en:
The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. Valid values:

- You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request or if no next query exists.
- If a next query exists, set the value to the **NextToken** value returned in the previous API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：

- 第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
- 如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的**NextToken**值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Valid values: **1** to **100**. Default value: **20**
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。取值范围：**1**~**100**，默认值为**20**
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the VPC NAT gateway to which the FULLNAT entries belong.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
要查询FULLNAT条目所属VPC NAT网关的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The protocol type of the Redirection Port. Valid values:

- **TCP**: forwards TCP packets.
- **UDP**: forwards UDP packets
parameters.help_zh:
转发端口的协议类型，取值：

- **TCP**：转发TCP协议的报文。
-  **UDP**：转发UDP协议的报文
parameters.name: ip_protocol

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the NAT gateway to query.

> You must specify at least one of **FullNatTableId** and **NatGatewayId**
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的NAT网关的ID。

>**FullNatTableId**和**NatGatewayId**参数至少输入一个
parameters.name: nat_gateway_id

parameters.help_en: The NAT IP address in the FULLNAT entry to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的FULLNAT条目的NAT IP地址
parameters.name: nat_ip

parameters.help_en: The frontend port in the FULLNAT entry to query. Valid values: 1 to 65535
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的FULLNAT条目的前端端口值，取值范围：1～65535
parameters.name: nat_ip_port
